{{Top|leg}}
'''Ruskakks''' were scavengers native to [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]]. They lived in nests, sometimes built under [[thyssel]] bushes.

"Son of a ruskakk" was a common insult referencing the ruskakk.
